what: Claim-by-claim status record for KAI's identity and independence: what is proven, on which build, and — explicitly — what is not. Companion to docs/KAI_SOUL.md, docs/KAI_RUNTIME_ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/KAI_HARNESS.md.
rule: Fix the record to match the evidence. Every claim names (a) its status tag, (b) whether it is FILES EXIST or KAI FUNCTIONALLY OWNS THE MECHANISM, and (c) the build it was verified on. A claim with no execution evidence is NOT PROVEN; a claim that cannot be exercised here because an external dependency is absent is BLOCKED_EXTERNAL. A file that exists is not a mechanism that works.

tags.UNIT PROVEN: exercised by the repo's unit/integration tests, or verified by an exhaustive static check (grep over the tree) where the claim is about code structure — at the named build.
tags.INTEGRATION PROVEN: exercised through two or more real components (HTTP route -> runtime -> subsystem; real server + real worker endpoint), captured or test-driven.
tags.END-TO-END PROVEN: a live capture shows the user-visible behaviour, on the named build.
tags.MOCK ONLY: exercised only against mocks/fixtures, never a real component.
tags.NOT PROVEN: claimed in code or docs but has no execution evidence, or the mechanism does not exist.
tags.BLOCKED_EXTERNAL: cannot be proven on this machine because an external dependency is absent.
